context: M6 o1. Sunday, the Arden's lobby bar. Rita behind the bar. Four women at the back table.

lines.speaker: char.rita_haines
lines.text: Sit down, sugar. Nobody makes a good decision standing up.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule one: I don't hold money I can't count. Rule two: I count everything.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Twenty women, five dollars a week, one woman a month takes the pot. Claudette's month.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Del, that cop's so cheap he tips in subway tokens. I'm short this week.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: You're short and you're wearing powder on your cheek in July. Who did that?

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: The door. The door did it. Big mean door. Can we do the money?

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: We do the money. Then we talk about the door.
